ttl = open(GRAPH_TTL).read()
import re
# find zone names for Z01-Z05 in F3
for z in ['Zone_F3_Z01', 'Zone_F3_Z02', 'Zone_F3_Z03', 'Zone_F3_Z04', 'Zone_F3_Z05']:
    pat = z + ' a '
    i = ttl.find(pat)
    if i > -1:
        start = ttl.rfind('\n', 0, i) + 1
        end = ttl.find('\n    ref:hasExternalReference', i)
        block = ttl[start:end]
        # find rdfs:label
        m = re.search(r'rdfs:label "([^"]*)"', block)
        label = m.group(1) if m else "N/A"
        print(f'{z}: label={label}')
        # also find Air_Temperature_Sensor
        m2 = re.search(r'([^.;,]+Air_Temperature_Sensor)', block)
        print('  sensor:', m2.group(1) if m2 else 'none found in block')

ttl = open(GRAPH_TTL).read()
import re
# Find each zone air temp sensor point URI and its hasTimeseriesId
for z in ['Zone_F3_Z01','Zone_F3_Z02','Zone_F3_Z03','Zone_F3_Z04','Zone_F3_Z05']:
    # The point URI likely bldg:Zone_F3_Z0X.Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor
    for suffix in ['Zone_Air_Temperature_Sensor','Air_Temperature_Sensor']:
        pt = f'bldg:{z}.{suffix}'
        i = ttl.find(pt)
        if i > -1:
            start = ttl.rfind('\n', 0, i)+1
            # find the next sentence-terminating period after start
            seg = ttl[start:start+600]
            m = re.search(r'ref:hasTimeseriesId "([^"]*)"', seg)
            m2 = re.search(r'ref:hasExternalReference <([^>]*)>', seg)
            print(pt, ' tsid=', m.group(1) if m else None, ' extref=', m2.group(1) if m2 else None)
            break
